headline: ARI @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 4.34 at SFG 3.54, with a projected total of 7.88. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: ARI moved -0.55 runs while SFG moved -0.08, changing the projected margin by -0.47 runs. The projected total fell -0.63, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +12.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Eduardo Rodriguez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Corbin Carroll, Ketel Marte, Luis Arraez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adrian Del Castillo, Ildemaro Vargas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
